description: This Dart source file defines the NetworkRepository class, which provides an abstraction over network operations such as fetching user profiles and WebSocket communication within a Flutter app. It manages dependencies on API clients and environment configurations, facilitating network interactions and mock mode handling.

classes.name: NetworkRepository
classes.description: A repository class that encapsulates network-related operations including profile fetching and WebSocket communication, with support for mock modes and default dependency injection.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the user profile via the ProfileApi.

methods.name: connectWs
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection through WsClient.

methods.name: wsMessages
methods.description: Provides a stream of messages received over WebSocket.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping message over WebSocket unless in mock mode, useful for debugging.
